ORDINANCE IX OF 2002
ELECTORAL ROLLS (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE IX OF 2002
(An Ordinance further to amend the Electoral Rolls Act, 1974)
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
11th February, 2002]
F. No.2(1)/2002-Pub., dated
11-2-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President hereby
published for general information:-
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Electoral Rolls (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 2, Act XXI of 1974

ORDINANCE IX OF 2002
ELECTORAL ROLLS (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE IX OF 2002
(An Ordinance further to amend the Electoral Rolls Act, 1974)
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
11th February, 2002]
F. No.2(1)/2002-Pub., dated
11-2-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President hereby
published for general information:-
2.Amendment of section 2, Act XXI of 1974.--In the Electoral Rolls
Act, 1974 (XXI of 1974), hereinafter referred to as the Act, in section 2, in
subsection (2) for clauses (a) -and (b) the following shall be substituted,
namely:--
"(a) in
rural areas, a village or a census block; and
(b) in urban
areas,--
(i) where
there is a municipal ward or census block, such ward or census block;
(ii) where
there is no municipal ward or a census block, a well- defined mohallah or a
street; and
(iii) where
the ward or census block, mohallah or street is too big, a well-defined part
thereof; or. "
